steps.name: unlock-and-organize-github
steps.command: set -eu; git fetch --prune --tags origin; test $(git rev-parse origin/main) = 61f9f29a028fc31f6e1640daf4cfa12fdc1badeb; echo 'Removing main branch protection'; gh api -X DELETE repos/MichalMatu/tracker/branches/main/protection; echo 'Creating immutable baseline tags'; if ! git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/stability-baseline-2026-09-06 >/dev/null; then git tag -a stability-baseline-2026-09-06 61f9f29a028fc31f6e1640daf4cfa12fdc1badeb -m 'Baseline before Stable Core recovery'; fi; if ! git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/archive-field-mvp-2026-07-07 >/dev/null; then git tag -a archive-field-mvp-2026-07-07 ce222cf770112d54065bb2c2992b43a826e01e13 -m 'Archived Field MVP work snapshot'; fi; git push origin refs/tags/stability-baseline-2026-09-06 refs/tags/archive-field-mvp-2026-07-07; echo 'Merging stability guide PR'; gh pr merge 3 --merge --delete-branch; git fetch --prune --tags origin; NEWMAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main); echo NEWMAIN=$NEWMAIN; if ! git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/stability-plan-v1 >/dev/null; then git tag -a stability-plan-v1 $NEWMAIN -m 'Stable Core recovery plan accepted'; fi; git push origin refs/tags/stability-plan-v1; if git ls-remote --heads origin archive/field-mvp-work-20260707 | grep -q archive/field-mvp-work-20260707; then git push origin --delete archive/field-mvp-work-20260707; fi; echo '=== FINAL REMOTE BRANCHES ==='; git fetch --prune origin; git branch -r; echo '=== FINAL TAGS ==='; git tag --sort=-creatordate; echo '=== MAIN PROTECTION CHECK ==='; gh api repos/MichalMatu/tracker/branches/main/protection || true; echo '=== OPEN PRS ==='; gh pr list --state open --limit 20; echo '=== MAIN HEAD ==='; git log -1 --oneline origin/main
